title: Ctrl+Space opens an empty command palette
body:
No palette exists and the key is not claimed.

## Proposal

Ctrl+Space draws a box over the centre of the body, above the clients, with
the title "command palette" and nothing in it; keys go to it and Esc closes
it. The chrome gains an overlay layer with transparency for this, drawn
above client surfaces. What the palette does is a later milestone.
close_reason: Done in the commit titled 'Lay panes out as a split tree with anchors and a Ctrl bar', 2026-11-06, with unit tests on the layout model for bar hit areas and boundary dragging. The bar, the drag and the palette need a hand on keyboard and mouse to check and are untested on screen as of this close; Jack is the tester.
